name: Hybrid Schedule Change Request
goal: Employee requests to change their hybrid work schedule for the next month.
constraints: Schedule must comply with company policy (minimum 2 office days/week).

phases.description: User asks to update their hybrid schedule for the next month.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot asks for the new schedule details.
Bot validates the schedule against policy.

phases.description: Bot confirms the schedule has been updated.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot message includes the new schedule and effective date.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
